notes.title: New Update for Chernobyl Death May Die
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I want to thank all the users who bought my game. For me, this is very valuable and motivates me to continue working on the project.

After the release, I did not sit idly by, but fixed errors and bugs in the game. Thanks to streamers and reviewers on YouTube, the error with the further passage of the cave was fixed. Also, the lighting on the very first level has been fixed.

In addition, three new scenes with monsters have been added that are waiting for your arrival. Believe me, it will be very scary.

Thanks for reading the news. And enjoy your game.
